aimech.name: aimech
aimech.description: A provenance-bearing projection of AIO terminology, with separately curated evidence and discussions. Ontology membership does not establish efficacy, benchmark performance, safety, or causal mechanism.

mech_shared.name: mech_shared
mech_shared.description:
Canonical, byte-identical LinkML module shared across the Mech knowledge bases (CultureMech / MIM / CommunityMech / TraitMech). It carries three domain-general record sections ported from monarch-initiative/dismech:

  * Discussion — the discourse / "knowledge gap" layer. A broad supertype
    (kind = KNOWLEDGE_GAP, OPEN_QUESTION, CONTROVERSY, CURATION_TODO,
    EMERGING_HYPOTHESIS, INTERPRETATION, HUMAN_MODEL_MISMATCH) with a
    lifecycle status, hash-anchor `attaches_to` pointers into the importing
    record's sections, optional `proposed_experiments` resolution sketches,
    and a `SupportingReference` evidence block.

  * Dataset — a lightweight reference to a public dataset (omics, sequence,
    phenotype). Its `dataset_type` / `repository` enums are the faithful UNION
    of the existing CultureMech and CommunityMech enums (plus microbial
    additions) so the Phase-2 migration of those two repos is loss-preserving.

  * CrossCorpusLink — a provenance-bearing link to a record in another Mech.
    The importing schema owns the relation vocabulary and which slots admit
    links. Sharing a protein or a reaction supplies a curation lead, not an
    assertion of record equivalence or biological mechanism.

The module is SELF-CONTAINED: it defines its own `SupportingReference` evidence class (and `SupportLevelEnum`) rather than referencing each repo's `EvidenceItem`, so it validates standalone, imposes no per-repo dependency (MIM has `MappingEvidence`, not `EvidenceItem`), and never collides with an importing schema's classes. Each record keeps its own primary `EvidenceItem` for record-level claims; discussions/datasets carry their own lightweight `SupportingReference` citations.
Vendored byte-identical and sha-pinned across the Mech repos (see culturebotai-claw#7). Do not edit one copy in isolation — change it once and re-vendor + re-pin everywhere.

broad_biological_records.name: Artificial Neural Network
broad_biological_records.definition: A network based on a collection of connected units called artificial neurons modeled after biological neurons.

broad_biological_records.name: Spiking Hidden Layer
broad_biological_records.definition: A hidden layer that makes connections to an additional, heterogeneous hidden layer; modeled after biological neural networks.

broad_biological_records.name: Survival Analysis
broad_biological_records.definition: A machine learning task focused on methods for analyzing the expected duration of time until one or more events occur such as death in biological organisms or failure in mechanical systems.

matching_claims.statement: The study compares six pivot strategies on three generated graph families and protein-interaction, needle-exchange and ticker-text networks, using repeated progressively enlarged pivot sets and exact centrality as the comparator. The score vectors are scaled to sum one. Prose describes Euclidean and inversion distances, while plots label the latter weighted inversion number. Observed-network sizes differ between Table 2 and figure labels, and the text-network betweenness experiment permits multiple edges despite the simple-graph core. No unified numeric benchmark denominator, unreported weighting rule, universal strategy superiority or biological-function prediction is asserted.

The source applies the method to weighted karate and collaboration networks, an unweighted football network and a historical yeast protein-interaction component. Its planted random-module comparison reports limitations relative to Girvan–Newman, so no universal detection advantage follows. Protein transport, essentiality and functional explanations remain hypotheses rather than causal evidence. Finite-temperature membership, coarse-grained recursion, localized distance approximation and the later distance-profile dissimilarity method are separate extensions, not steps of this original attractor-closure algorithm.

The source interprets small index values as similar graph perspectives and uses them in historical synthetic, social and yeast-network clustering examples. Its performance and protein-function hypotheses concern the full hierarchy pipeline and specific data, not independent validation of this pairwise functional or causal biology. This record follows the inspected arXiv v1 normalization; journal-byte equivalence and version-specific numerical changes were not established.

ontology_and_entity_boundary_distinction.zero_uniprot_prefixes_or_slots: All 3 LinkML schema modules (src/aimech/schema/aimech.yaml, src/aimech/schema/curated_concept.yaml, src/aimech/schema/mech_shared.yaml) declare 0 biological entity prefixes (UniProt, UniProtKB, HGNC, NCBIGene, GO, PR, PDB) and 0 protein-example or gene-example slots. In mech_shared.yaml, the word 'protein' appears only in cross-fleet docstrings warning that 'Sharing a protein or a reaction supplies a curation lead, not an assertion of record equivalence or biological mechanism' and in DatasetTypeEnum.PROTEOMICS (an unimported class in AIMech records).
ontology_and_entity_boundary_distinction.aio_taxonomic_and_mereological_axioms: 442 parents edges and 71 BFO:0000051 ('has part') relationships across 442 generated AIO records classify AI layers, models, networks, tasks, mathematical functions, preprocessing methods, training strategies, and biases; 0 AIO records mention UniProt or proteins, and only 3 AIO records (AIO:ArtificialNeuralNetwork, AIO:SpikingHiddenLayer, AIO:SurvivalAnalysis) mention 'biological' to contrast artificial neural units with biological neurons or note time-to-event subjects.
ontology_and_entity_boundary_distinction.curated_protein_term_occurrences_are_lim: Across all 1,487 maintained curated AI-concept records, 0 records contain UniProt accessions/CURIEs and only 3 records (AIMech:BrandesPichPivotCentralityEstimation, AIMech:ZhouAttractorCommunityDetection, AIMech:ZhouRandomWalkDissimilarity) mention the token 'protein'. In all 3 records, the token appears strictly inside kind='limitation' claims noting that historical benchmark evaluations on yeast protein-interaction networks do not establish biological-function prediction, protein transport/essentiality mechanisms, or causal biology.
ontology_and_entity_boundary_distinction.broad_biological_term_classification: Across all 95 curated records matching broad biological/bioinformatics/genomic/biomedical tokens, every match falls into one of four mutually exclusive non-protein-instance categories: (1) explicit negative-scope or benchmark disclaimers in limitations or claims (62 records, including the 3 historical yeast protein-interaction network disclaimers); (2) bio-inspired optimization/neural-learning metaphors where 'genes' or 'biological' denote candidate solution encodings or heuristics (10 records, e.g. GeneticAlgorithm, GuidedGeneticAlgorithm, EstimationOfDistributionAlgorithms, RegularizedEvolution, OjaLearningRule, SwarmIntelligence); (3) acronym/homonym collisions (3 records: 'RNA' = Regularized Nonlinear Acceleration in RegularizedNonlinearAccelerationOfFixedPointIterations and LSvrgAndLKatyushaLooplessVarianceReducedGradientMethods; 'GENET' = constraint-satisfaction neural network); and (4) downstream biomedical/genomic/ontology evaluation dataset contexts for general-purpose statistical, graph-clustering, or NLP methods (20 records, e.g. CliXO, NeXOOntologyAlignment, NeXOOntologyConstruction, HACE, HACES, HACQ, CovariatePoweredCrossWeightedMultipleTesting, LeftTruncatedCauchyCombinationTest, SupervisedPrincipalComponents, HiddenMarkovModelWithAuxiliaryMemory).

future_representation_assessment.candidate_native_analog: Biological UniProt protein examples do not apply to AIMech's AI-concept domain or LinkML schemas. Even if AIMech later curates AI architectures designed for computational biology (such as protein language models or equivariant structure-prediction networks), those records will represent the mathematical/algorithmic architecture or model family under CuratedAIConcept (with benchmark datasets captured in EvaluationContext.dataset_and_split when performance claims are curated), never biological UniProt protein records or molecular mechanism assertions. Stage 3 (protein_examples) should remain not_applicable in workflow/mech-workflow.yaml.
